title: Auth/transport separation is correct and should be defended
description: TransportConfig (TLS/trust-root) and AuthProvider (per-request credentials) are independent traits that compose freely. A contributor might suggest merging them into one 'client config' trait to reduce the API surface. They should not: the separation enables CustomCaTransport + BearerAuth, DefaultTransport + BasicAuth, etc., without combinatorial implementations. Merging would either force a CartesianProduct of impls or remove the ability to mix them.
